sections.Profile:
Hayburners is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Games Inc. in June 1951. Designed by Harry Williams and Sam Stern, the game features a horse-racing theme, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1951
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Dual Theme, Backbox Gimmick, Racing, Sports, Horses, Original Theme, Horse Racing
